units.source_text: 这小姐的父亲常陆亲王在世之日，由于时运不济，

en.t: When Hitachi no Miya, the young lady's father, was still alive, his fortunes had been poor,

units.source_text: 宫邸里也一向无人来访。

en.t: and hardly anyone ever came to visit the residence.

units.source_text: 亲王身故之后，这庭草荒芜的邸宅越发无人上门了。

en.t: After the prince passed away, still fewer people came to the mansion, where the garden grasses had grown wild.

units.source_text: 如今这个身份高贵、盖世无双的美男子源氏公子的芳讯常常飘进这里来，

en.t: Now, however, letters from Lord Genji, that noble and peerless handsome gentleman, often found their way there,

units.source_text: 年轻的侍女们都欢喜庆幸，大家劝小姐：

en.t: and the young gentlewomen were all delighted and grateful, urging their lady,
"You really must write him a reply."

units.source_text: 然而小姐惶惑不知所措，一味怕羞，连源氏公子的信也不看。

en.t: But the young lady was bewildered and at a loss, so overcome with shyness that she would not even look at Genji's letters.
Dainagon no Myobu thought to herself,

units.source_text: “那么，我就找个适当机会，叫两人隔帘对晤吧。

en.t: "In that case, I will find a suitable opportunity and have the two of them meet across the curtain.

units.source_text: 如果源氏公子不喜欢她，就此罢休；

en.t: If Lord Genji does not take to her, the matter can end there;

units.source_text: 如果真有缘分，就让他们暂时往来，总不会有人责怪的。”

en.t: but if there is truly a bond between them, no one will blame them for keeping company for a while."

units.source_text: 她原是个风骚泼辣的女人，就擅自决定，并不将此事告知她父亲。

en.t: She was by nature a flirtatious and forceful woman, so she decided the matter on her own and did not tell her father about it.
